summary: Master strategic marketing frameworks, ROI analysis, and GTM planning. This 5-day course empowers leaders to drive growth through data-driven brand positioning.
lede: Marketing strategy connects market opportunities with organizational goals and financial performance. Designed for decision-makers and functional leads, this training addresses how to turn market insight into strategic plans through market segmentation and positioning, competitor analysis, and marketing performance measurement. It also covers pricing, channel strategy, integrated communications, and reporting results to leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for high-level decision-makers and functional leads who must integrate marketing outcomes with broader corporate strategy and financial performance.
audience: Chief Executive Officers of mid-sized firms focused
modules: Strategic Marketing Foundations and Market Dynamics
Product Strategy and Value Proposition Design
Digital Transformation and AI in Marketing
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of business operations. At least 3-5 years of experience in a management or leadership role is recommended. Familiarity with basic financial statements (P&L) is beneficial but not mandatory.
